set.body: Phase 1 review finding 2 of 8. R/result.R effect_geometry() can mark structurally invalid data as a full result: empty effect marginals, non-triangular packed widths, wrong marginal schemas or column counts, and block stores whose manifests or readers cannot supply the claimed geometry. Add a centralized consumption-boundary validator for packed triangular width, effect count and identity, marginal schema and dimensions, index consistency, store manifest completeness, and receipt/result consistency. A full result must be certified only after complete structural validation. Done when malformed in-memory and block-backed objects are rejected by focused adversarial tests.
set.title: Validate complete geometry before certifying it as full
